lines.en: label callharukaafternoon:
if senseisad == True and saracamp2 == False:
I don't want to call her right now...
lines.zh: 我现在不想叫她……

lines.en: jump callafternoon
if harukanumber == True and day89 == False:
I think I should probably get to know Haruka a little better before calling her.
lines.zh: 我觉得打电话给 Haruka 之前，应该先多了解她一点。

lines.en: jump callafternoon
elif harukadate1 == True and harukadate5 == False:
I tap on Haruka's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点下 Haruka 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: There's no answer...She's probably at work anyway.
lines.zh: 没人接……她大概在上班吧。

lines.en: I hope she doesn't still feel weird about what happened at the bar the other night.
lines.zh: 希望她别还为那天晚上在酒吧的事觉得别扭。

lines.en: jump callafternoon
else:
I tap on Haruka's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点下 Haruka 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey, it's me. What are you up to right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，是我。你现在在干什么？

lines.en: if cafeclosed == False:
: I'm still at work. Did you need something?
lines.zh: : 我还在上班。有什么事吗？

lines.en: Damn. Looks like Haruka's busy. I should probably wait until she's done working to ask her out.
lines.zh: 该死。看来 Haruka 在忙。我大概该等她下班再约她。

lines.en: : It's nothing urgent. I can just call you later.
lines.zh: : 没什么急事。我晚点再打给你。

lines.en: : Okay...I'm sorry! Make sure you really {i}do{/i} call me later though, okay?
lines.zh: : 好……对不起！不过你{i}一定{/i}要记得晚点打给我，好吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, Haruka. {i}I make my own rules.{/i}
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Haruka。{i}规矩是我自己定的。{/i}

lines.en: : ...What?
I hang up the phone and decide to call someone else instead.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，决定改打给别人。

lines.en: else:
: Oh, you know. Just trying to get my life back together and convince the government I wasn't having sex in my cafe when we both know I was.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是在努力把生活重新拾起来，还得说服政府我没在自家咖啡馆里做爱——虽然我们俩都清楚我做了。

lines.en: : Sounds like fun.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺有意思的。

lines.en: : It's not.
lines.zh: : 不可以。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, I guess I'll leave you alone then.
lines.zh: : 那我就不打扰你了。

lines.en: : Okay. Talk to you later, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好。那就回头再聊。

lines.en: : See you, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 再见，Haruka。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and decide to call someone else instead.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，决定改打给别人。

lines.en: jump callafternoon
